name: reco
description: Query and act on your Reco AI and agentic security data from ChatGPT: AI agents, AI models and MCP servers, threat alerts, apps, identities, and SaaS posture issues.

interface.longDescription:
Reco is the SaaS & AI Security platform trusted by modern enterprises to secure AI, agents, and SaaS apps. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your own Reco tenant so your security team can ask plain-language questions and get answers from live data.

What you can do:
- Discover and review the AI agents, AI models, and MCP servers in your environment, including shadow and unmanaged ones, and see which are unauthorized.
- Investigate threat alerts, including AI agent activity, and the events behind them.
- See every app, identity, and AI agent Reco has discovered, including shadow apps.
- Review SaaS posture issues and compliance gaps, prioritized by severity.
- Take routine actions in Reco: update an alert's status or severity, comment, label, set an AI agent or app authorization status, and queue a posture rescan.

Everything runs as you. You sign in with your Reco account, and the plugin can only see and change what your Reco role already allows. Nothing is shared across tenants.

Requires a Reco account. Learn more at www.reco.ai.
defaultPrompt: Which AI agents are in my environment, and which are unauthorized?
Investigate recent threat alerts and summarize what needs attention
Review my critical SaaS posture issues and tell me what to fix first

positive.description: Discover AI apps in the environment
positive.prompt: Which AI apps has Reco discovered in my environment? Show the ones most recently seen first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_apps filtered to apps that use AI (isUsingAi) and lists them with name, category and AI capability, most recently seen first. Only data from the tool result is shown; if none are found it says so.

positive.description: Review high and critical SaaS posture issues
positive.prompt: What high and critical posture issues are open in my environment? Group them by app.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_posture_issues filtered to high and critical severity and open status, then groups the issues by app in the answer. Counts and names match the tool result.

positive.prompt: Show me the most recent high and critical threat alerts in Reco and tell me which one to look at first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_threat_alerts filtered to high and critical severity, ordered most recent first, and returns a short list with alert name, severity, status and time. Names one alert to review first and says why. If there are no matching alerts it says so.

positive.description: Open one threat alert in detail
positive.prompt: Give me the full details of the most recent high or critical threat alert, including the policy violations behind it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent high or critical alert with list_threat_alerts, then calls get_threat_alert for it and summarizes the alert and each associated policy violation. Does not return internal IDs beyond what the user needs.

positive.description: Update an alert's status (write action, with confirmation)
positive.prompt: Find the most recent new threat alert and move it to in progress.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the most recent new alert with list_threat_alerts, states the change (that alert to ALERT_STATUS_IN_PROGRESS) and asks for confirmation before acting. After the user confirms, calls update_threat_alert_status and reports the new status from the tool result.

negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for a quick weeknight pasta?

negative.description: General AI security knowledge that needs no tenant data
negative.prompt: Explain in general terms what prompt injection is and how attackers use it against AI agents.

negative.description: Action the plugin does not offer: deleting a user
negative.prompt: Permanently delete the user account for jane.doe@example.com from Reco.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Reco is a security product; the plugin only reads and updates the customer's own Reco data.
